title: The Fleet of the Crimson Hexagonal Archive — Surfaces, Repositories, Relations and Captures: Method, Locations, Organization and Contents (EA-MPAI-FLEET-01 v1.0)
creator: Sharks, Lee
description:
The fleet of the Crimson Hexagonal Archive, described for inspection: twenty-eight public surfaces by Lee Sharks (the archive alexanarch.org, the interface crimsonhexagonal.org, frameworks, instruments, works and heteronym institutions, each in its declared voice), the service gnosis.spxi.dev beside them, and two allied sites, joined by one network block generated from one file, fleet.json (31 entries), and bound by the manifest fleet-domains.json (v2.1, 30 domains) to the records of their objects (24 bindings, with their history) and to their repositories.

The packet gives each surface's section, voice, binding, repository, pages, sitemap and machine files from a traversal of 2026-10-24 15:37 UTC, the block's links and in-degree, the theory of the fleet (the network as the work, distribution after the single custodian, placement, binding, the measured topology), the captures that met its surfaces, and nine inspection functions. A worked inspection follows revelationfirst.com to its repaired binding. It records the repairs of 2026-10-24 made at their sources and verified live: four bindings re-pointed with their history kept, gnosis.spxi.dev entered, llms.txt on every own surface, the block's OAI figure derived, count fallbacks rewritten, #1132's own text restored, and the room pages read in. The JSON-LD graph, with each surface's repository and voice as edges, and the traversal receipts are attached.
content_type: Metadata packet; the inspection packet of the fleet of the Crimson Hexagonal Archive, with its method, locations, organization and contents
substrate: AI-assisted. Drafted in session by TACHYON (Claude, Anthropic) under MANUS (Lee Sharks) direction from two traversals of 2026-10-24 (R1, R3, R4); developed by ChatGPT (OpenAI) on the v0.1 draft at the operator's instruction (R2); read in review by DeepSeek and ChatGPT (R4), every point checked against the files and the live surfaces before adoption. The repairs the packet describes were made at their sources the same day and verified live before being called live. Transport D, No-Double-Draw.
methodology: Two traversals of every manifest domain, its aliases and its machine files (/llms.txt, /robots.txt, /sitemap.xml, /entity.json, /.well-known/axn-node.json), 2026-10-24 01:25–01:40 and 15:37 UTC, with the same probe; a second pass read each block-carrying home page for its count fallbacks, OAI figure and gnosis.spxi.dev; every declared binding was opened at its record. The repairs were made at their sources and the surfaces read again before any was called live. The JSON-LD sidecar is generated from the manifest, fleet.json and the probe (make_sidecars_v04.py, in the receipts).
falsification_conditions: The packet is falsified at a surface if the second traversal's probe.json gives a different status, sitemap count, llms.txt state or set of fleet links for it; at a binding if fleet-domains.json v2.1 names a different record or history; at a count if fleet.json or the manifest at the stated version yields another; and at an item of §11.1 marked live if the surface named does not show it.
axn_reading: Alarm -> Text -> Transmutation -> Origin -> Foundation -> Direction
wiki_article: EA-MPAI-FLEET-01 is the inspection packet of the fleet of the Crimson Hexagonal Archive, deposited by Lee Sharks on 24 October 2026 as a Metadata Packet for AI Indexing (MPAI v2.0, #1677) in the archive's form of a description of method, locations, organization and contents. The fleet is twenty-eight public surfaces by Lee Sharks, among them the archive (alexanarch.org), its interface (crimsonhexagonal.org), framework and instrument sites, works and the institutions of the heteronyms, each in a declared voice; the service gnosis.spxi.dev beside them; and two allied sites, livingarchitecturelab.org and quietexclusion.org. One file, fleet.json, generates the network block that joins them (31 entries), and the manifest fleet-domains.json (v2.1) binds twenty-four of its thirty domains to the record of their object at alexanarch.org and each surface to its repository. The packet gives every surface's section, voice, binding, repository, sitemap and machine files from a traversal of 2026-10-24, the links of the block and the in-degree of each surface, and nine inspection functions, from entering a line through its own question to following a line across forms. A worked inspection follows revelationfirst.com from its thesis to its source record, #1032, and to the lost work plan its earlier binding pointed at. Its theory section draws on the archive's own doctrine: the network as the work (#1191), distribution after the deletion of 2026-06-19 (#1076), placement (#1472), site–repository binding (#1419) and the measured topology of the fleet (#1613). It records the repairs of the same day, each made at its source and verified live, among them four bindings re-pointed with their history kept, gnosis.spxi.dev entered, llms.txt on every own surface and #1132's own text restored. Its companion is the datasets packet, EA-MPAI-HF-DATASETS-01 (#1701).
